title: ux.juice_applied
description: Emitted when a M12 juice rule fires on a UI surface or in-mission surface — hover, click, swap, banner-slide, hit-stop, critical-punch, reload-ding, pickup-glow. kind is a snake_case identifier of the rule. accessibility_suppressed is true when reduce_motion / reduce_shake / reduce_flash short-circuits the animation. M12 spec § Juice rules.
